title: Localized Chromatin Rewiring Shapes Rhythmic Transcription within a Stable 3D Genome in Rice
authors: zhang, y., Chen, G., Guo, L. et al.
abstract: How spatial genome architecture coordinates rhythmic gene transcription across scales in plants remains poorly understood. Here, we integrated bridge linker Hi-C (BL-Hi-C), H3K9ac ChIP-seq and RNA-seq at six time points across a 24-h circadian cycle in rice.
